title: KEGG Carotenoid Biosynthetic Pathway Flux and Lutein Xanthophyll Photoprotection under High PPFD Regimes
author: Dr. vmffkxhs2362
abstract: Lutein is a major functional carotenoid protecting light-harvesting complex II (LHCII) from singlet oxygen damage. We analyzed metabolic flux through the KEGG sly00906 pathway in spinach leaves under high PPFD (350 μmol/m²/s) combined with supplemental UV-A (385nm). Transcriptional up-regulation of lycopene epsilon-cyclase increased lutein concentration by 52%, optimizing photoprotection and nutritional value.
key_findings: Supplemental UV-A (10 μmol/m²/s) stimulated total carotenoid accumulation by 46.2%.
Lutein content reached 8.4 mg/100g FW without inducing photoinhibitory biomass loss.
Violaxanthin de-epoxidase (VDE) activity increased 2.8-fold, enhancing thermal energy dissipation.
